notes: The three bare material nouns (silver, gold, purple) each take their supplied *of* under rule 33, the words standing before the nominals whose case-function licenses them; none is a direct object reached through a supplied preposition under rule 44.
*of it* after *the seat* is the suffix's whole rendering under rule 19's pronominal-rectum sentence, headed on the pronoun, while the noun keeps only its own word with the supplied *the*.
*being paved* keeps the construction-supplied copula with the passive participle under rule 20; it is not an added lexical verb.
